title: The Last Wardrobe
author: P. M. Winterbourne
blurb: Lior Lockridge, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
